# Autumn fair

Agreed at the committee meeting on 2 September 2026.

- Date: Saturday 14 November 2026
- Place: Riverside community hall, Mill Lane
- Open: 10:00 to 15:00; stallholders set up from 08:30
- Pitches: one standard pitch per stall, no double pitches, since the hall holds 24
- Stall fees: in `fees.md`
